reason: I already pay for Wox and a card terminal, and my regulars come three or four times a week, so I know them by face and they pay at the counter. I don't need a QR code on the table and a second system for my staff to learn, and I don't want another fee on every payment on top.
objection: It's another system next to my POS and another per-transaction fee, and my small margins can't take both. My older regulars won't pay by phone anyway, so I'd pay 59 lari for something few of them would use.
would_change_my_mind: If it ran inside Wox so my staff learned nothing new, with no extra transaction fee beyond what I pay now, and a nearby café showed me it brought in new guests.
